name: Turkey A La King
description: A creamy turkey dish made with mushrooms, celery, and green pepper, served over toast or rice.

recipeInstructions.text: In a skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add mushrooms, onion, celery, and green pepper. Cook until vegetables are tender.
Remove vegetables from skillet with a slotted spoon and set aside.
In the same skillet, blend flour into the butter to make a roux. Gradually add chicken broth and milk, stirring constantly.
Bring mixture to a boil and cook for 2 minutes, or until it thickens.
Add reserved turkey and vegetables to the sauce. Heat through.
Serve over hot toast, biscuits, or rice.

keywords: turkey a la king, creamy turkey, mushrooms, celery, green pepper

_similar.name: Turkey or Chicken Pies
_similar.description: Individual or large pies filled with turkey or chicken, vegetables, and a creamy sauce, topped with a homemade pastry crust or biscuits.
_similar.recipeYield: Multiple individual pies or 1 large pie

recipeInstructions.text: Melt margarine with salt and pepper over low heat. Add flour and gradually add broth, cooking until smooth.
Sauté chopped onion and celery until tender.
Boil carrots until thoroughly cooked.
Mix cooked carrots with peas and the sauce made earlier.
For the pastry, mix flour, salt, and baking powder with butter. Add milk to form a dough.
Fill small pans or a large pie plate with the turkey or chicken mixture and top with pastry crust or biscuits.
Bake until the crust is golden brown.

_similar.name: Cheese & Broccoli Soup
_similar.description: A creamy broccoli and cheese soup with a rich, velvety texture.

recipeInstructions.text: Melt butter in a large saucepan.
Cook onions until tender; do not brown.
Add chicken stock and broccoli; bring to a boil.
Whisk in flour and cook for 3 minutes.
Return to heat; cook and stir until mixture thickens.
Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes; do not boil.
Puree mixture until smooth.
Heat through with milk, cheese, and seasonings.

_similar.name: Cheese & Broccoli Soup
_similar.description: A creamy broccoli and cheese soup with a smooth texture.
recipeIngredient: 3 cups cooked broccoli (fresh or partially aged)

recipeInstructions.text: Melt butter in a large saucepan and cook onions until tender, but not brown.
Whisk in chicken broth and broccoli. Bring to a boil.
Add flour mixture and cook for 3 minutes.
Return to heat and simmer for 15 minutes, reducing heat. Do not boil.

_similar.name: Microwave Corn Chowder
_similar.description: A creamy corn chowder made in the microwave with potatoes, carrots, celery, and cheddar cheese.
recipeIngredient: 2 cans (14¾ oz each) cream style corn

recipeInstructions.text: Place water in a 2-quart microwave-safe dish; cover and heat until boiling.
Add potatoes, carrots, celery, onion, salt, and pepper. Cook, uncovered, on high for 8 to 10 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender; set aside (do not drain).
In a 3-quart dish, microwave butter on high for 50 to 60 seconds or until melted.
Stir in flour until smooth. Gradually stir in milk. Cook, uncovered, on high for 6 to 7 minutes or until thickened, stirring every 2 minutes.
Add the cheese. Heat for 1 to 1½ minutes or until the cheese is melted.
Stir in corn and reserved vegetables. Cook on high for 2 to 3 minutes or until heated through.

_similar.keywords: microwave corn chowder, creamy soup, cheddar cheese

_similar.name: Chili Turkey
_similar.description: A hearty chili turkey dish made with ground turkey, kidney beans, and whole wheat spaghetti.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a large heavy pot over medium heat. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it starts to brown, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the turkey and cook, stirring to coarsely crumble until no longer pink, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Stir in chili powder, tomato paste, broth, cinnamon, cumin, salt, coriander, and oregano. Bring to a simmer.
Partially cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until the meat is tender and the broth is slightly thickened.
Meanwhile, pour the beans (with juice) into a microwaveable bowl. Microwave on high for 1 to 2 minutes or until heated through. Drain and cover to keep warm.
Cook the pasta as directed.
Place pasta on a plate, ladle chili over pasta, and top with beans, then with cheese.

_similar.keywords: chili turkey, ground turkey, kidney beans, whole wheat spaghetti
